senses.gloss: ch. same, to cause delay, to let wait.
units: Targ. Job XXXII, 4 (h. text חִכָּה).—Part. pass. מְתִין waiting, detained, fr. which מְתִין, מְתֵין to wait for, hope; to be slow.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Lamentations 2:16">Targ. Lam. II, 16</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 2:12">Targ. Esth. II, 12</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 56:7">Targ. Ps. LVI, 7</cite>.
Ib. CXXX, 5 מְתֵינִית Ms. (ed. אַמְתִּינֵית Af.); a. e.—
<cite ref="Yevamot 63a:10">Yeb. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>מְתוֹן נסיב וכ׳</he> be slow in taking a wife, opp. <cite ref="S01721"><he>קפוץ</he></cite>.—V. <cite ref="M03056"><he>מְתִין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 2:25">Targ. Y. I Gen. II, 25</cite> (v.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 18:5">Gen. R. s. 18</cite>, quot. in <cite ref="M03079">preced.</cite>). Ib. XXXI, 28 <he>לא אַמְתַּנְתַּנִי</he> thou didst not wait for me (give me an opportunity, h. text <he>נטשתני</he>).
<cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 4:18">Targ. I Chr. IV, 18</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Yevamot 91b:5">Yeb. 91ᵇ</cite> <he>איבעי לה לאַמְתּוּנֵי</he> she ought to have waited.
